description: This file contains unit tests for the heartbeat runner module, specifically testing the behavior of 'runHeartbeatOnce' function under different configurations. It uses Vitest testing framework and imports functions from related modules to set up test environments, mocks dependencies, and verifies interactions.

methods.name: installHeartbeatRunnerTestRuntime
methods.description: Sets up and installs the test runtime environment for heartbeat runner with optional configuration like including Slack.

methods.name: seedMainSessionStore
methods.description: Seeds or initializes the main session store with given configuration and last interaction data.

methods.name: withTempHeartbeatSandbox
methods.description: Sets up a temporary sandbox environment for heartbeat tests, providing temporary directory, store path, and reply spy.

methods.name: runHeartbeatOnce
methods.description: Executes a single instance of the heartbeat process with specified configuration and dependencies.
